MCD.rationale: McDonald's is a world-class franchise with structurally high margins (~47% operating, ~32% net) and strong cash generation (Q3 2025 OCF $3.43B, +25.3% YoY). The balance sheet is improving (equity from -$5.18B to -$2.16B YoY). However, several factors temper the score: (1) WTI crude at $99.27 (+64% over the window) is a material, unquantified headwind to franchisee economics and consumer traffic that has not yet flowed through reported financials (latest data is Q3 2025); (2) growth is grinding lower — revenue +3.0% YoY, EPS +1.6% YoY, U.S. same-store sales at 0.3% in 2024; (3) valuation cannot be confidently assessed due to broken PE series, but an indicative ~24.6x on low-single-digit growth offers no clear margin of safety; (4) shareholder returns exceed 107% of FCF per one source, raising sustainability concerns given negative equity. The Q4 2025 results (10% revenue growth, $3.12 adjusted EPS) from web context are encouraging but represent a single quarter. The franchise quality is undeniable, but the combination of slowing growth, emerging oil-shock risk, and no clear valuation discount keeps the score modestly positive rather than strongly so.
key_factors: Structurally high margins: operating margin ~47%, net margin ~32% stable across all observed quarters through Q3 2025
Strong cash generation: Q3 2025 OCF $3.43B (+25.3% YoY), 3-quarter sum $7.86B annualized ~$10.5B
Balance sheet improving: equity improved from -$5.18B (Q3 2024) to -$2.16B (Q3 2025), $3.02B improvement
WTI crude at $99.27 (+64% over window) — major unquantified headwind to franchisee costs and consumer demand, not yet in reported financials
Low-single-digit growth: revenue +3.0% YoY, EPS +1.6% YoY in Q3 2025; U.S. same-store sales 0.3% in 2024, slowest in decade
Valuation unverifiable: PE series broken across all 12 observations; indicative ~24.6x on non-contiguous EPS sum (not authoritative per data limitations)
Capital return sustainability concern: shareholder returns 107% of FCF per statsalpha.com source; negative equity leaves no balance-sheet cushion
Q4 2025 from web context: revenue $7.0B (+10% YoY), adjusted EPS $3.12 beating estimates — encouraging but single-quarter
Franchise model: 95% franchised, 61% of revenue from franchise fees/rent, real estate moat provides durable competitive advantage
Stock at $302.53, mid-range of 52-week $283.47-$341.75, quarterly delta -1.1% — market has not rewarded or punished the earnings trajectory
